opposite_exit_reconciliation.interpretation: The audited prefix falsifies a missed eligible opposite-exit routing bug. The giveback is consistent with the frozen no-profit-lock policy, not proof that this policy is economically optimal.

Recommendation: Keep the current live exit contract unchanged during this open lifecycle. Reconcile its authoritative close and continue the separately frozen future-only long-and-short profit-lock experiment.
Why now: The long reached 105.83 bps completed-bar MFE and later gave back 121.12 bps, so the first question was whether an eligible opposite close was missed. Exact routing evidence shows none occurred.
Evidence reviewed: The exact V58 checkpoint snapshot and a 1,973,554,330-byte complete prefix containing 292,966 decision-ledger rows, including 55 post-entry BRENTOIL evaluations.
Observed problem or opportunity: The frozen no-lock policy can surrender open profit while waiting for an opposite eligible breakout, the 80-bps stop, or the 24-hour deadline. This is an exit-policy research opportunity, not a confirmed implementation defect.
Applicable market regime: Exact source-native BRENTOIL fresh15-v2 long lifecycle. Canonical regime is unavailable, so no broader regime claim is made.
Alternatives considered: Patch opposite routing, close this lifecycle post hoc, install a transported profit lock immediately, add a fixed target, or preserve the native control and collect future-only evidence. The routing patch is falsified; immediate policy changes would overfit an open long.
Expected upside: Preserving the native control provides an attributable final outcome while the frozen future-only comparison can test profit retention across both configured sides.
Main risks and failure modes: The open trade can lose more before exit; the stop can gap; no opposite signal may occur; one open long is selection-prone; counterfactual locks omit future funding and exit slippage; and cadence may remain sparse or one-sided.
Validation completed: Run/profile/route/lifecycle identity, healthy runtime, exact exit plan, completed-bar path, all post-entry route evaluations, same-side withholding, and absence of any eligible opposite evaluation were source-bound and reconciled.
Validation still required: The authoritative close reason and fill, final fees/funding/slippage, final completed path, and at least one future-only technically complete lifecycle per configured side under the frozen comparison.
Success metrics: Obtain one complete post-boundary long and one complete post-boundary short with exact costs and all frozen policy outcomes. This updates diagnosis only and is not a promotion gate.
Failure / rollback triggers: No live change exists to roll back. Escalate if the venue stop disappears, runtime identity changes, the position closes without an attributable lifecycle, or a future ledger revision reveals an eligible opposite signal without a close action.
Confidence level: High on the technical no-missed-opposite conclusion for the frozen prefix; low on economic exit-policy inference because the lifecycle remains open and is a single long observation.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Reconcile the authoritative close of xyz:BRENTOIL:520642502465, then compare that result with the frozen native control and future-only policy outcomes without retuning.
falsifiers_and_update_triggers: A later exact route row at or before the frozen prefix boundary contains an eligible BRENTOIL short without its matching close action.
The authoritative close or final costs expose a lifecycle accounting defect.
Future-only both-side evidence supports or contradicts a frozen profit-lock policy after exact costs and largest-winner sensitivity.
The checkpoint, decision-ledger prefix, or generator hashes do not reproduce.
limitations: This artifact freezes an open lifecycle and is not its final outcome.
Absence of an eligible opposite intent does not prove that no better exit exists.
Completed one-minute OHLC extrema are not tick-continuous execution paths.
No claim is made that a profit lock is optimal or that the native policy is broken.
This artifact cannot route, size, enter, close, restart, retune, or promote a strategy.
